specDepartures.spec: Acceptance 2: each of the four workflows (Tests included) also runs on pull_request closed, in the same concurrency group with cancel-in-progress, with every job skipped.
specDepartures.plan: Envoy and Contracts, Docs and Worker Image run on closed as specified; Tests (pr-and-main.yaml) gets no closed trigger, so its runs for an unmerged closed PR finish as before.
specDepartures.evidence: The spec's shared context forbids a run that skips the tests posting at a head another run tested. A skipped job's check run passes for GitHub's required-check rule and for the daemon (packages/daemon/internal/classify/required.go:101-111; newest check-run id per name wins, packages/envoy/internal/cistore/cistore.go:470-480). lint, typecheck and test are required (ruleset on main), so a Tests closed run would replace a red or cancelled result at the PR head with a pass; GitHub starts no run on a reopen while the PR conflicts, so the pass can stand. Envoy, Docs and Worker Image are not required, so their skipped closed checks decide nothing. A merged PR's Tests runs at its head have already finished, so the waste kept is unmerged closes only; the implementer measures it.

acceptance: 2. Closed pull requests: Tests (pr-and-main.yaml) is excluded; Envoy and Contracts, Docs and Worker Image run on closed as written.
outcome.scope: Acceptance 2 does not apply to pr-and-main.yaml unless the architect chooses the spec as written or a fail-closed canceller.
